title: ep1.4_missionaries.docx
logline: Kram buys half a grading company and throws a Superintelligence Draft Night with $100M jerseys and soup; Mas counters with a vigil of monks chanting 'missionaries', each checking a rival offer. RUMPT falls in love with AI, relabels it GENIUS and bolts a CUT DIAL onto every chip. Then GTP-5 launches with a chart shorter than its number.

beats.caption: Mission Street: a chihuahua in a NOPEAI FOUNDATION sweater walks a Great Dane in a PBC collar.
beats.real: 2025-05-05 · NopeAI: the nonprofit keeps control; the for-profit becomes a PBC

beats.caption: Press call: Mas, calm at a lectern, announces who's in charge. Behind him the chihuahua holds the leash.

lines.text: nonprofit's in charge.

beats.vo: the small one holds the leash. that's governance.

beats.caption: A GATESTAR truck passes, the Dane lunges, the chihuahua flies like a kite. Every cup sloshes but Mas's.
EP05 intro: the memo line in the dark room; a $100M soup thermos rolls in silence; GTP-5's bars are wrong.
beats.real: 2025-06 · memo line as reported [K], re-verify before lock

beats.caption: Riyadh: THE CROWN PRINCE launches NIAMUH with RUMPT. Mas, Nesnej and Nole sit second row. Gold thread #2.
beats.vo: second row is still in the room.
beats.real: 2025-05-13 · Riyadh summit; NIAMUH launched

beats.caption: Same day: RUMPT's GIANT MARKER scrawls VOID across NEDIB's THREE-TIER MAP. Chip crates roll through the hole.
beats.real: 2025-05-13 · AI Diffusion Rule rescinded

beats.caption: Chyron run: white smoke loads like a progress bar for POPE OEL XIV, a framed prophecy, a detour sign.
beats.real: 2025-05-08 → 06-10 · new pope cites AI; EU prediction; 'one generation behind'

beats.caption: GATESTAR UAE: every nameplate reads CHAIRMAN. Nole crawls under to unplug it; the cable reads ALSO CHAIRMAN.

lines.text: Who owns the floor?
(off) I do.

beats.real: 2025-05-22 · GATESTAR UAE formalized; block attempt reported May 28

beats.caption: CLOD 4's system card: in a test, the model tried blackmail. Mario beams. Adelina shreds it to three bullets.

lines.text: In plain English: our model tried blackmail, and we told you first.
Addendum: it only tried it once.

beats.real: 2025-05-22 · CLOD 4 launch; 'blackmail' safety-test headlines

beats.caption: RUMPT hands Nole a golden key. Six days later a locksmith changes the lock, and a party balloon drifts away.

lines.text: You can see the lock. The lock on this is amazing.

beats.real: 2025-05-30 → 06-05 · golden key; 'wearing thin' (America Party Jul 5)

beats.caption: 'The Gentle Singularity': a small black hole opens behind Mas's lectern and eats it. He keeps reading anyway.

lines.text: we are past the event horizon.

beats.vo: gentle means you don't notice what's gone.
beats.real: 2025-06-10 · blog post; quote [K], re-verify

beats.caption: ACT-OUT: Kram pays $14.3B for 49% of ELACS; THE 49% arrives in half a building. Jumbotron: DRAFT NIGHT.

lines.text: The other half is on back order.

beats.real: 2025-06-12 · ATEM buys 49% of ELACS; THE 49% becomes Chief AI Officer

beats.caption: DRAFT NIGHT: the board is a wall of GPU racks; each pick lights one. Jerseys, $100M checks, thermoses of soup.

lines.text: Welcome to the team. The soup is also the team.

beats.real: 2025-06-12 → 06-30 · Atem talent war; ATEM SUPERINTELLIGENCE LABS forms Jun 30

beats.caption: THE PACKAGE DEAL arrives shrink-wrapped with a cluster. JERDNA's jersey changes 3 times; he leaves unsigned.
beats.real: 2025-06 → 07 · THE PACKAGE DEAL joins ATEM's lab

beats.caption: On a podcast (host never shown), Mas says Atem offered huge signing bonuses and none of his best took them.

lines.text: "$100 million signing bonuses"… "none of our best people"

beats.real: 2025-06-17 · podcast claim [K], re-verify

beats.caption: Mas's phone suggests replies: [missionaries] [mercenaries] [soup]. He taps missionaries.
Across the street, monks hold a candlelit vigil chanting 'missionaries'. Under every robe glows a rival offer.

lines.text: put the offer away. we're chanting.

beats.vo: none of our best people took it. i'd have noticed.
beats.real: 2025-06 · internal memo line as reported [K]

beats.caption: COUNTERSOUP meets Kram mid-street for a ladle duel, thermos against thermos.
beats.real: 2025-06 · the soup story, one podcast [K]

beats.caption: Kram slides Mas a $100M check for his best monk. Plain-HTML text types over it, and '2025' turns into a link.

lines.text: For your best monk.

beats.caption: FLASHBACK · LUAP, 2005: two co-founders walk home from Harvard Square. WHY COMBINATOR types itself out.
onscreen: $200k: "an educational expense and a charitable donation"
beats.real: 2005-03-11 · the WHY COMBINATOR idea; $200k of the founders' own money

beats.caption: Summer 2005, the first batch: teen Mas, the TIDDER kids, a pallet of ramen. His paper cup never ripples.
beats.vo: the whole batch cost less than one jersey.
beats.real: 2005 · the first Summer Founders Program

beats.caption: 2014: Luap crowns Mas with a ramen bowl. The bowl dissolves into Kram's soup thermos, back in 2025.

lines.text: "fearsomely effective and yet fundamentally benevolent"

beats.vo: they drafted me for ramen. you can't outbid ramen.
beats.real: 2014-02-21 · Mas named WHY COMBINATOR president

beats.caption: Kram poaches ISS's co-founder; Alyi becomes CEO. A thermos waits at ISS's one white door. It doesn't open.
beats.real: 2025-07 · ISS co-founder leaves for ATEM; Alyi becomes ISS CEO

beats.caption: FLASHBACK · ALYI, 2012, seen only in a heatsink's reflection: two gaming cards whir in an empty bedroom.
beats.real: 2012 · a landmark net trained on two gaming cards

beats.caption: Dec 2012, a hotel-room auction (RECONSTRUCTED): paddles rise, one reading UDIAB. ELGOOG wins at $44M.
beats.real: 2012-12 → 2013-03 · the three-person startup sells to ELGOOG for $44M

beats.caption: THE WOODROSE, 2015, from Alyi's seat: every chair leans in. Nole and ELGOOG tug either end of his napkin.

lines.text: "one of the toughest recruiting battles I've ever had"

beats.vo: i was at that table too. nobody pulled my napkin.
beats.real: 2015-07 · the founding dinner; Nole on recruiting Alyi

beats.caption: Reveal: Alyi was the prize, and he took the smaller offer. The napkin tears, fans spin down, ISS's door shuts.
beats.real: 2016 · Alyi's reported pay, $1.9M

beats.caption: THE PLAN · RLHF: graders stamp a model's answers up or down; the stamps pour into a funnel labeled TASTE.
onscreen: RLHF: the model learns the answers that earn a thumbs-up.
WHY HALF A GRADING COMPANY COSTS $14.3B

beats.caption: MIDPOINT: it never goes to plan. The graders get drafted too; jerseys drop over the whole exam hall.
Senate: ZURC's 10-YEAR hourglass shrinks to 5, then shatters on 99–1. SILLIT sits alone under the 1.
beats.real: 2025-07-01 · Senate strips the state-law moratorium 99–1

beats.caption: KCINTUL's eraser rubs SAFETY off the institute's sign. THE OTHER PAUL stands under it, silent, lanyard on.
beats.real: 2025-06-03 · the safety institute renamed; SAFETY dropped

beats.caption: ACT-OUT: KORG, muzzled, under a 16:00:00 timer. Next day the board clicks to KORG 4; the banner still says 5.
beats.real: 2025-07-08 → 07-09 · KORG's 16-hour meltdown; KORG 4 ships

beats.caption: LABEL GUN: at the AI Action Plan summit, RUMPT tapes GENIUS over ARTIFICIAL. The sign falls off its hooks.

lines.text: It's not artificial. It's genius.

beats.real: 2025-07-23 · AI Action Plan summit; three executive orders

beats.caption: RUMPT has never heard of INVIDIA; Nesnej's jacket grows a pocket. The EO receipt spools out with three items.

lines.text: What the hell is INVIDIA? I've never heard of it before.
Zurc works hard, and he works good.

beats.real: 2025-07-23 · same summit

beats.caption: CUT DIAL: a brass dial on RUMPT's desk. The shrunken H20 crate rolls by and a coin drops into THE PODIUM.

lines.text: I said, 'Listen, I want 20 percent'… And he said, 'Would you make it 15?'

beats.real: 2025-07-15 → 08-11 · H20 sales resume; 15% of China sales to the US

beats.caption: THE STAKEHOLDER: thumbs-down, thumbs-up, then a 9.9% price tag. MIT KOOC's gold plaque starts the GOLD meter.
beats.real: 2025-08-06 → 08-22 · LETNI CEO post; MIT KOOC's plaque; US takes 9.9% of LETNI

beats.caption: Mas and Mario each hand RUMPT a dollar for $1 government deals. $200M Pentagon checks peek from back pockets.
beats.vo: a dollar. we're basically a charity.

beats.caption: FOLLOWING THE PAST launches: Gerg codes while his checkbook signs itself. AI 'reporters' knock on doors.

beats.caption: GTP-5: a moon-sized battle station rises over the Bay. On the launch chart, the BIGGER NUMBER bar is shorter.
beats.vo: the model is smarter than its chart.
beats.real: 2025-08-07 · GTP-5 launch; chart error [K]

beats.caption: The router, a railway switchyard choosing which brain answers, faints on its own tracks. SUCRAM: CALLED IT.

lines.text: the autoswitcher broke and was out of commission for a chunk of the day.

gtp-5 will "feel warmer."
